name: ai-context-meter
title: AI Context Meter
description: A small ring and token count for the model's context window. The ring changes color near the limit, and a popover lists what fills it.

props.name: limit
props.description: Size of the context window, in tokens.

props.name: breakdown
props.description: What fills the window, as label and token pairs. Shown in a popover on hover or focus.

props.name: warningAt
props.description: Fraction of the window at which the ring turns to the primary color.

props.name: dangerAt
props.description: Fraction of the window at which the ring turns to the destructive color.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
